product_overview: A web-based music media platform focusing on dynamic content presentation with a robust admin system for content and user management, featuring secure authentication and media upload capabilities.
core_goals: Restore and enhance administrative control with a fully functional admin dashboard and elevated privileges.
Fix critical security permissions and database policies to allow seamless media uploads and public content access.
Provide a reliable authentication system integrating Google OAuth with user roles and profile management.
Enable dynamic featured content management with media playback and pagination.
Organize music content by genre with local storage optimization.
Support user engagement through a fan club feature for posts and media sharing.
key_features: Complete Administrative Dashboard ('God Mode') with Dark/Gold theme and comprehensive configuration options.
Robust authentication system with Google OAuth, user profiles, and admin verification.
Dynamic featured content section with pagination and live audio visualizations.
Secure media upload section integrated with Supabase storage and detailed error handling.
Music genre library with local storage support for easy browsing.
Fan club feature allowing users to share posts and media within the community.
Database schema and Row Level Security policies enforcing role-based access and public read permissions.
user_flow_summary: User logs in via Google OAuth and is authenticated with role determination.
Admin users access the Settings page to manage site configurations and featured slots.
Admins upload media via the Upload Section, with error feedback on permissions or network issues.
General users browse featured content with media playback and navigate the genre library.
Users participate in fan club activities, posting and sharing media within the community.
Public visitors can view content with guaranteed read permissions enforced by security policies.
validation_criteria: The admin dashboard loads correctly with full functionality and visual fidelity.
Database policies allow admins to insert, update, delete, and allow public read access securely.
Media uploads succeed without permission or network errors, verified by test uploads.
Authentication system correctly identifies admin users and shows admin badges.
Featured content appears correctly on the homepage and updates with new entries.
Fan club posts and media display correctly and are stored persistently.
Local storage integrates properly for genre browsing to enhance user experience.
